tasks.title: Declare the Identity account model and generate the identity-schema migration
tasks.dod: The generated EF Core migration is diffed against the staged 01_create_identity_schema SQL, applies and reverts cleanly, and both unique indexes refuse a colliding insert in a test.

tasks.title: Build the Session entity owning the 14-day idle and 90-day absolute expiry rules
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass on both sides of the 14-day and 90-day boundaries against an injected instant, and Session.IsExpired is the only place either figure appears.

tasks.title: Build the Account entity, its sentinel errors and the progressive-delay rule
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass for each creation invariant and for the delay curve: zero through the 5th failure, at least 2 s at the 6th, at least 30 s at the 10th, and a reset once 15 minutes pass with no attempt.

tasks.title: Map the Session entity and generate the sessions-table migration with its three indexes
tasks.dod: The generated migration is diffed against the staged 02_create_sessions SQL, applies and reverts cleanly, carries the three indexes with the filtered predicate on IX_Sessions_RevokedAt, and leaves LastSeenAt unindexed.

tasks.title: Generate the data-protection key-ring table so sessions survive a redeploy
tasks.dod: The generated migration is diffed against the staged 03_create_data_protection_keys SQL, and an integration test shows a payload protected by one application instance being unprotected by a second instance over the same database.

tasks.title: Declare the session ports and implement them over EF Core
tasks.dod: Integration tests against the SQL Server container prove Find is a single primary-key query materialising no account, the activity stamp writes at most once an hour, and revoking one session leaves the account's other sessions live.

tasks.title: Put ASP.NET Core Identity behind IAccountStore, with lockout off and hashing tuned
tasks.dod: A unit test holds the hashing parameters at the 100 ms floor, and integration tests prove the dummy verification costs a comparable time, lockout is off, and an account with 20 recent failures still verifies its correct password immediately.

tasks.title: Implement the RegisterAccount use case: create the account and open its session in one step
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove the happy path writes exactly one account row and one live session row and returns the display name, while each refusal leaves the store untouched — no account, no session, no counter.

tasks.title: Implement the SignIn use case with the progressive delay and the indistinguishable refusal
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove a successful sign-in opens one session and zeroes the failure count, the wrong-password and unknown-address refusals are identical and comparably timed, and the delay curve and 15-minute reset hold against a controllable clock.

tasks.title: Implement the SignOut use case and declare the session-revocation notifier port
tasks.dod: A unit test proves the notifier is called exactly once per revocation after the store write, and an integration test proves revoking one session leaves the account's other sessions live while the revoked cookie is no longer recognised.

tasks.title: Set up the single ProblemDetails handler and the antiforgery requirement
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove all eight accounts.* codes are produced with the contract's status, title and detail, that the AC-05 and AC-05b bodies are byte-identical, that a state-changing request without the antiforgery token is refused 403 with its session intact, and that an unmapped exception leaks no exception text.

tasks.title: Recognise a session on every request: the authentication handler, the cookie and the key ring
tasks.dod: An integration test per flow-5 branch passes through GET /api/v1/accounts/me — live, absent, revoked, 14-day idle, 90-day absolute — with byte-identical refusal bodies, one primary-key query per recognition, an httpOnly secure same-site cookie, and no 14 or 90 day literal anywhere in the Api project.

tasks.title: Expose POST /api/v1/accounts with the per-source registration rate limit
tasks.dod: An integration test drives AC-01 end to end with a cookie immediately accepted by GET /api/v1/accounts/me, the 6th registration from one source within a minute is refused 429 with a positive Retry-After, each refusal returns its contract code, and a forwarded client address is honoured only when the request arrives from the configured proxy.

tasks.title: Expose the sign-in and sign-out endpoints and the Api-side revocation notifier
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove sign-in returns 201 with a usable cookie, the two refusals are identical in status, headers and body, sign-out returns 204 with the cookie cleared and exactly one session revoked while a second stays live, and the notifier is called once per sign-out.

tasks.title: Build the web API client, the session bootstrap and the signed-in shell with sign-out
tasks.dod: Component tests against a mocked transport pass for the loading, visitor, account and error states, prove a 401 from any call lands the client on the sign-in form without a reload, prove sign-out leaves the visitor state, and prove the display name is rendered while the email address is not.

tasks.title: Build the registration screen with every refusal state the contract can return
tasks.dod: Component tests against a mocked transport pass for all six states, prove every field keeps its value after each of the four refusal codes, prove the 429 state names the wait in seconds, and prove a 201 leaves the client signed in without showing a sign-in form.

tasks.title: Build the sign-in screen with one indistinguishable refusal
tasks.dod: Component tests against a mocked transport pass for all four states, assert the refusal renders identically for a wrong password and an unregistered address, assert no format or length pre-check blocks a request, and assert a 201 lands the client in the signed-in shell.

tasks.title: Write the three quality-scenario test suites, including the anti-lockout regression
tasks.dod: All three QG suites pass through WebApplicationFactory against the SQL Server container, the anti-lockout regression fails when lockout is flipped on, every time-dependent test drives IClock, and the redeploy-survival row appears as an explicitly skipped test citing roadmap step 4.

tasks.title: Write the four session rules into the repository where the fifteen-minute read finds them
tasks.dod: docs/session-rules.md states all four rules, each naming its enforcing file and proving test as a resolving link plus an observation a reader can make from outside, README.md links to it, and the two deferred commitments are labelled with the roadmap step that verifies them.

tasks.title: Add the expired-session cleanup hosted service with its startup and daily runs
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove rows opened more than 90 days ago and rows revoked more than 14 days ago are removed while live and recently-revoked rows survive, the guard prevents a second concurrent run, and a failing sweep neither stops the host nor blocks the next run.

tasks.title: Serve the AC-12 delay from the attempt being made, reset the stored count after the quiet period, and record a failure before waiting
tasks.dod: With 5 prior failures the next wrong attempt is held >= 2 s and with 9 prior failures >= 30 s; after 15 quiet minutes a failure stores count 1, so the next typo is free; a failure is persisted even when the client abandons the delayed request; the 5-minute ceiling is recorded in spec §6 and ADR 0010; tests assert real floors (no `>= 0`).

tasks.title: Hold refusals for unregistered addresses on the same curve, so the wait does not reveal registration
tasks.dod: After N wrong attempts against an unregistered address, the (N+1)th is held by the same GuessingDelay curve a registered address gets; the counter is in memory, keyed by a hash of the normalised address, never persisted; an integration test compares both paths after 5 failures.

tasks.title: Make the session cookie persistent and add the activity-stamp slack after the 14 days, not before
tasks.dod: Set-Cookie from register and sign-in carries a Max-Age equal to Session.AbsoluteLifetime (asserted); a session whose last real request was 14 days ago but whose stamp is up to 59 minutes older is still recognised, and none survives past 14 d + 1 h of inactivity (Domain boundary tests); openapi examples show Max-Age.

tasks.title: Count only accepted registrations against the per-source limit and prune stale sources
tasks.dod: Five refused submissions followed by a valid one from the same source returns 201; the sixth accepted registration within a minute is still 429 with Retry-After; entries older than the window are pruned so the dictionary does not grow without bound (tested).

tasks.title: Accept every address MailAddress accepts and stop mapping unexpected Identity errors to a uniqueness refusal
tasks.dod: Registering o'brien@example.test and an address with non-ASCII letters succeeds; InvalidUserName is never reported as display_name_taken; an Identity error that is neither duplicate is thrown, not mapped to email_taken.

tasks.title: Return the stored address from register and sign-in, declare display_name_invalid, and prove the id is stable across the account's life
tasks.dod: Signing in with a differently-cased, padded address returns the email exactly as /me returns it; openapi.yaml declares accounts.display_name_invalid; one test registers, signs out, fails 3 times and signs in again, asserting the same id at every step.

tasks.title: Move Api registrations into AddAccountsApi, require TrustedProxies outside Development, and prove a trusted proxy's forwarded address is honoured
tasks.dod: Program.cs names no inner-layer type (only AddXxx calls); outside Development the app refuses to start when TrustedProxies is empty; with TrustedProxies set to the test peer, two different X-Forwarded-For values get separate counters (tested).

tasks.title: Raise the 48-hour cleanup alert as an error log so sad §7 monitoring can fire
tasks.dod: When HasNotSucceededRecently is true after a run, the service logs an error naming the last success; a test with a failing sweep and an advanced clock observes that log entry.

tasks.title: Render a refusal's title as its statement and its detail as the reason
tasks.dod: The taken-address, taken-name and rate-limit refusals read 'already registered', 'taken' and 'temporarily limited'; antiforgery_failed shows the server's detail; the retry sentence appears exactly once even when the detail already names the wait.

tasks.title: Present the sign-in form when a known session ends, and treat a 401 from any call as the end of the session
tasks.dod: A composed AccountShell + VisitorScreens test: a 401 on /me refetch while an account is cached shows the sign-in form; sign-out shows the sign-in form; a first visit with no session shows registration; the switch between the two is inside the card; a 401 from a non-/me query clears the session.

tasks.title: Keep register, sign-in and sign-out pending until the session is known, and stop truncating passwords
tasks.dod: A 201 writes the returned Account into the session cache before invalidating, so the form never re-enables into a visitor state; the registration password has no maxLength; sign-out is disabled and labelled 'Signing out…' while pending (all tested).

tasks.title: Define the theme tokens the vendored components read
tasks.dod: --color-destructive, --color-card, --color-card-foreground, --color-input and --color-ring are defined in @theme; a production build emits CSS for text-destructive, bg-card, border-input and ring-ring.

tasks.title: Type-check tests in their own program and drop vitest globals
tasks.dod: tsconfig.app.json excludes __tests__ and src/test and has no test types; tsconfig.test.json carries them; vitest runs without globals: true; tsc -b, lint and the web suite stay green.

tasks.title: Record lightningcss (MPL-2.0, build-time only) as a licence exception
tasks.dod: An Accepted ADR names lightningcss, its MPL-2.0 licence, the path that brings it in (@tailwindcss/vite), why it never ships in the bundle, and the condition that would revisit it; architecture-map links it.

tasks.title: Cap failed sign-ins per request source, counted before the verification, so hanging up no longer escapes the AC-12 delay
tasks.dod: A failed-sign-in slot is reserved for the request source (RequestSource.Of, the trusted-proxy-resolved address registration already uses) BEFORE the password is verified and released only on a successful sign-in, so an abandoned or parallel attempt still counts; once a source holds the cap (default 20 failed sign-ins per 15-minute sliding window, the figure named as a constant and recorded in the amendment) the next attempt from it is refused WITHOUT verifying the password, with a new declared problem `accounts.sign_in_rate_limited` (429 + Retry-After) routed through the AccountProblems wording table; the cap applies identically to registered and unregistered addresses (AC-05b) and a correct password from a different source is still accepted immediately (AC-12); the dictionary is bounded and pruned like RegistrationRateLimit (extract a shared sliding-window limiter if that keeps both simpler); openapi.yaml declares the 429 on POST /api/v1/sessions; an ADR 0010 amendment records the decision, the figure and the residual risk (one account attacked from many sources), and spec §6.1 and the sad §8 "Guessing protection" row say the same; integration tests: the 21st failure from one source gets 429 without a verification, parallel hung-up attempts still consume slots, another source signs in with the correct password immediately, an unregistered address is capped identically.

tasks.title: Render the sign-in-rate-limited refusal on the sign-in screen with its statement and wait
tasks.dod: A 429 `accounts.sign_in_rate_limited` on the sign-in screen shows its title as the statement and its detail as the reason via statementAndReason, names the wait once, and keeps the form usable afterwards; it is never shown as "credentials invalid" and never ends the session; a component test in SignInScreen.test.tsx drives the 429 through the real api client.

tasks.title: Seed the failure compare-and-set with the count already read, and return the count actually written under contention
tasks.dod: RecordFailureAsync takes the ConsecutiveFailures / LastFailedAttemptAt already read by FindByEmailAsync as its first compare-and-set expectation, so an uncontended wrong password costs one UPDATE and no extra SELECT; only a missed write re-reads; after the retry budget the blind increment returns the value actually stored (read back, or OUTPUT inserted), never the stale `next`; the reset rule stays in GuessingDelay (Domain); tests: the uncontended path issues no re-read (observable through a counting interceptor or equivalent), the contended fallback returns the stored count, 6 parallel failures still get 1..6.

tasks.title: Name both password bounds, lock every declared problem in the contract test, and give a malformed body a declared problem
tasks.dod: The password_invalid detail names both bounds ("between 8 and 128 characters"), in AccountErrors, openapi.yaml and the AccountProblemsTests row, and the stale comment pointing at AccountProblems is removed; a 129-character password gets that refusal (RegisterEndpointTests); AccountProblemsTests has a display_name_invalid row, its stale "not in contracts" comment is gone, and it compares the full detail rather than StartsWith; the openapi 429 example matches what AccountProblems emits; a missing or malformed JSON body on POST /api/v1/accounts and POST /api/v1/sessions is answered with a problem carrying a declared `code` and status through the one ProblemDetails handler (never a 500, never a problem without a code), declared in openapi.yaml; RegisterEndpointTests:161 asserts the exact status and code.

tasks.title: Prove an unavailable session store fails closed, and word the test-plan row as the UI behaves
tasks.dod: An integration test replaces ISessionReader with one that throws and shows /api/v1/me answers a non-2xx application/problem+json and never a 200 or the account view; the test-plan.md edge row for "store unavailable" is re-worded to "fails closed: the failure view with retry is shown, never the account view"; any production change needed stays inside the one ProblemDetails handler.

tasks.title: Record the unknown-address counter limits, the 14 days + 1 hour boundary, and close the ADR 0003 question
tasks.dod: spec §6.1 and an ADR 0010 amendment record the unregistered-address counter as accepted residual risk (lost on restart, cap of 100,000 tracked addresses) and sad §5 lists the IUnknownAddressAttempts port; the test-plan.md rows for the AC-07 boundary and the data-model.md fixture state 14 days + 1 hour after the stamp, and sad flow 5 (or an ADR 0008 amendment) records why; the spec §8 ADR-0003 item is ticked with a link to ADR 0010 and ADR 0003 carries a "see ADR 0010" note; no code changes.

tasks.title: Measure cleanup staleness from the last success or the process start, so one failed startup sweep raises no alert
tasks.dod: HasNotSucceededRecently compares clock.UtcNow against LastSucceededAt ?? the instant the service was constructed; a first sweep that fails at t=0 raises no session_cleanup_stale error; a process that has never succeeded for more than 48 hours does; the existing success-then-49-hours test still holds.

tasks.title: Prove the registration limit holds under parallel submissions, and that an unexpected Identity error is not reported as a uniqueness refusal
tasks.dod: A test runs more than 5 parallel Reserve calls for one source on a test clock and asserts exactly PermittedPerWindow are permitted; Release of a refused decision is a no-op; an unexpected Identity error from CreateAsync surfaces as a 500 problem (not email_taken or display_name_taken) through a test double; if T35 extracted a shared limiter, the same concurrency test covers it.

tasks.title: Move keyboard focus to the new form when switching between sign-in and registration
tasks.dod: Activating "No account yet? Create one" or its sign-in counterpart moves focus to the new screen's heading or first field (not on the landing's first mount); VisitorScreens.test.tsx asserts toHaveFocus() after each switch; Tailwind only, no new dependency.

tasks.title: Darken the input border and focus-ring tokens to at least 3:1 against the background
tasks.dod: --color-input and --color-ring in src/index.css reach a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against --color-background (WCAG 1.4.11), in the light and, where defined, the dark theme; src/test/themeTokens.test.ts computes the ratio from the declared oklch values and fails below 3:1.

tasks.title: Remove the tracked crash dump and bring every task file status in line with the tracker
tasks.dod: grep.exe.stackdump is removed from the index and *.stackdump is git-ignored; every docs/features/accounts-and-sessions/tasks/*.md frontmatter status matches tracker.md.
